scopeLimits: Actual original image grouping follows per-phase native rendering: Apple appearance-live comes from MD3 initial cases with Apple+flipped mode; Apple tutorial-live returns to Apple initial config. Case title is not used as image design evidence.
Thirty-six Apple natural frames and all108 natural frames of the run are excluded from static goldens, even when their PNG hashes are identical.

Natural time-series proves six Apple appearance groups have two running spin animations with increasing currentTime. Six tutorial groups have empty animation arrays; they do not prove animation progress.

Narrow and tablet viewport captures deliberately show current scroll position; sticky header may cover content already above the viewport and lower controls/forms may be cut by the viewport bottom. They are not complete page or complete component evidence.

Project name long value may show only a segment. Textarea draft and tutorial name are visibly present; exact full values, original DOM identity and checked retention come from native assertions, not only PNGs.

Six search images show exact first LineEdit selected after real ArrowDown/ArrowUp and input focus ring. Native selected id/active descendant, Enter route and content focus are behavior evidence; no post-close final screenshot is claimed.
Drawer images show open navigation. Escape and trigger focus restoration are native assertions, not proved solely by open-drawer pictures.
Only original46 Apple PNGs were manually reviewed; other two designs and all full-run138 screenshots are not silently counted as viewed.

Forty-eight decoded frames from12 original native videos were viewed, not full playback or every instant. Requested seek times are recorded, exact selected-frame presentation times are not independently measured.
Video is800×450 with content scaled/padded by original recorder. Text/geometry in decoded frames is not used as a new pixel baseline or as full-resolution screenshot evidence.
Startup blanks, route loads, other-design phases and transition intermediates are retained and classified separately, not component failures or final Apple appearance approvals.

One intermediate dark-surface/dark-text readability concern is recorded for separate design review. The final46 original PNGs show no new obvious defect; this does not approve the whole theme transition.

No browser/capture/build/source edit or baseline update occurred. Only reports and decoded derivative observation evidence were written; original images/videos/reports remain intact. No canonical, baseline or verified coverage approval is granted.
